name: Vertice Bass
author: NucleoOS
description: Arcade bass fishing tournament in 3D: six lakes, eight species, three lures, line-tension fights and a record wall of your ten biggest fish.

descriptions.en: Arcade bass fishing tournament in 3D: six lakes, eight species, three lures, line-tension fights and a record wall of your ten biggest fish.
descriptions.it: Torneo di pesca arcade in 3D: sei laghi, otto specie, tre esche, combattimenti con la tensione della lenza e la bacheca dei tuoi dieci pesci piu grossi.
